parsed.basis: Bình Thuận is a south-central coastal province centred on Phan Thiết and the Mui Ne resort strip, where foreign tourists are routine in hotels, restaurants and beach venues and interaction with visitors is commonplace. Vietnam does not criminalise same-sex conduct or gender expression, but provides no discrimination protection based on gender identity and has not implemented legal gender recognition, so foreign passport and hotel-registration checks can expose a mismatch between documents and presentation to staff and police. Healthcare encounters may involve intrusive questioning and uneven access to gender-affirming care, prison and detention placement is not aligned with gender identity, and LGBTI organisations operate under surveillance with no region-specific protective machinery. Local conservatism and limited specialist services outside the tourist areas leave recourse mainly in larger cities.
